title: Bounded-flat homotopy representatives and their translates
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-derived-category]. For a homotopy object $X$, let $B_Y(X)$ mean that there exists a cochain complex $P$ of structure-sheaf modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] with an integer $b$ such that $P^i$ is a zero object whenever $b<i$, all $P^i$ are flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], and either $q_Y(P)=X$ or $q_Y(P)[1]=X$. This is a predicate about actual complex representatives, without a choice of data.
